generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE game VFX sprite animation atlas, eight sequential temporal frames of the SAME ground impact, for a fixed high top-down Korean historical fantasy tower-defense battlefield. Create a polished painterly animated-film-quality magic shockwave with softly sculpted ivory/silver dust ribbons, small warm pale-gold sparks, a cool blue-grey inner shadow, and delicate feathered edges. It should feel like a physical burst of air and illuminated dust expanding across the ground, not a logo, icon, UI ring or bright neon disk. Camera: straight overhead orthographic view of the ground so the images can be laid flat on a 3D terrain; no horizon. Entire image must have a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, including the spaces inside the burst. No floor, no ground tile, no background rectangle, no captions, no grid lines. Layout: EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, eight equal square cells; preferred canvas 1536 x 768. Read frames left to right, top row then bottom row. Every frame is perfectly centered at the same local cell center, same camera, same resolution and overall scale; only the effect evolves over time. Keep all content strictly within each cell with at least 12 percent transparent gutter on all four sides; no frame touches another cell. Frame 1: tiny sharp contact flash with a little curled dust. Frame 2: small expanding dusty arc. Frame 3: fuller shockwave with asymmetric soft folds. Frame 4: widest luminous crest, intricate painterly ripples. Frame 5: light starts dissipating into dusty ribbons. Frame 6: separated fading wisps and tiny drifting specks. Frame 7: only thin pale curled wisps, clearly dimmer. Frame 8: a few very faint fading specks and wisps, mostly transparent. Keep center mostly transparent from frame 3 onward so the soldier beneath remains readable. Use nuanced translucent silver-white and low-saturation neutral dust, suitable for tinting subtly to water blue, amber fire, celestial violet, or restorative jade in-game. Avoid opaque smoke clouds, hard geometric circles, thick outlines, excessive glare, explosions that fill the screen, symbols, characters, weapons, buildings, text, checkerboard backgrounds, duplicated frozen frames. This is a production raster game effect sheet, not a concept art illustration of a sheet.
